# Learning Platform Provider

Scope

Digital learning assets including documents, worksheets, and assessments

High-Velocity Content Remediation EdTech Learning Platform Provider

- Over 8,000 existing learning assets required rapid accessibility remediation.
- Strict timelines tied to academic cycles and institutional compliance requirements.
- Content originated from multiple authors, formats, and quality levels, creating inconsistency.
- Limited in-house capacity to manage high-volume remediation with WCAG/Section 508 alignment.

### Our Approach

Set up a high-velocity remediation workflow with parallel workstreams to meet aggressive timelines.

Remediated documents, assessments, and learning materials to WCAG, Section 508, and PDF/UA standards.

Implemented quality checks at multiple stages using a combination of automated and manual validation.

Ensured final deliverables met accessibility, usability, and compliance requirements before release.

- Converted 8,000+ learning assets into fully accessible formats within 60 days.
- Enabled on-time academic readiness, mitigating compliance and delivery risks.
- Improved accessibility, usability, and consistency across high-usage course materials.
- Built a repeatable, scalable remediation model that the client can use for future content modernization.
